rows.literal: | 19 | line 5, before paired display | ens. | — | medium | Small low waves and a terminal ink point; plural les precedes it. | ens. fits les and the two objects listed below. |
| 19 | after Par hyp. de récurrence | on a | — | low | Three very small marks; the equality follows. | on a introduces the immediately following equality. |
| 19 | first large union sign | \coprod | \bigsqcup | medium | The bar projects at both feet. The inside of the bowl has a round bottom. | The surrounding text does not settle this reading. |
| 19 | under large union, overwritten index | J | — | low | A loop at the foot of the revised K survives. | The surrounding text does not settle this reading. |
| 19 | lead-in above U = … | On a | — | low | A dark loop, short wave and separate point precede donc. | On a combines with the following donc to introduce the display. |

| 19 | struck word after dans la | somme | réunion | low | The strike goes through nearly the whole lower-case body. The next line begins réunion. | somme would precede the replacement réunion; the next lines also use sommer. |
| 19 | after se borner à | sommer | — | medium | The middle is a run of humps followed by sur les. | The author restricts the indices of the written union. |
| 19 | after K₁ | cet | — | medium | Tall final stroke of the first word and point after the second; soit begins the clause. | cet fits ens. in the immediately following position. |

| 19 | line 3, before card | avec | — | low | Three short detached strokes, with a slight curve on the last. The case just introduced supplies the complement. | avec links Cas général to its stated cardinality. |

| 19 | first U of the paired formula | U with an entrance flourish | a cancelled = before U | low | Two light horizontal strokes run into the top of the first stem. Later U's start from above. | The surrounding text does not settle this reading. |
| 19 | below first display | l’une | l’un | medium | There is a low return after the n. The preceding abbreviated ens. would favour l’un. | The abbreviation ens. favours the masculine l’un. |

| 19 | brace line 1, underneath K₀ | Σ with lower α | Σ with lower 0 | medium | Left points, diagonal and two parallel strokes outline a sigma behind the vertical K. A smaller loop intertwines with the foot. | The written Σ’s on the two lines below have α as their lower index. |

source_parts.location_label: cancelled Sigma with lower alpha/zero beneath K_0

scope_notes: The source table names twelve local doubtful-reading rows. Its first-U notation recurrence maps to R10 without another original doubt-row count. R12 identifies one overwritten predecessor group with an indexed-alpha/zero alternative; local glyph, index and state observations remain separately describable under that one original identity. No statuses have been decided before the independent returns and root ink review.
